reviewed: noun_override defects exposed by fixing pluralizeNoun in lang_es.js
_finding: Correcting pluralizeNoun let the engine be checked against all 643 single-word overrides, which act as hand-written ground truth. The engine now reproduces 633 of them. Of the 10 remaining, five were the override being wrong and two had a misspelt base. The other three (foul, start-up, óptico-optometrista) are loanwords and a hyphenated compound that no general Spanish rule covers, so their overrides are correct and stay.

rows._was_base: mocasiín -- misspelt, so the app displayed 'el mocasiín' as the singular
cuádricep -- a back-formation; the Spanish singular is cuádriceps
